name: Cloudflare R2
summary: List, fetch and publish objects in Cloudflare R2 through its S3-compatible API, signed with an R2 access key pair.

fields.name: access_key_id
fields.label: Access key ID
fields.help: Create an R2 API token in the Cloudflare dashboard; it yields this pair.

settings.name: account_id
settings.label: Cloudflare account ID
settings.help: Shown in the Cloudflare dashboard; it is part of the endpoint.

operators.summary: List keys under a prefix, with sizes and ETags, as a manifest.
Fetch objects into the artifact store, hashed with BLAKE3, resumable by range.
Publish artifacts under a key prefix with multipart upload and a recorded digest.

notes: Buckets created in a data jurisdiction such as the EU use a different endpoint host and need the s3-compatible connector with that host as its endpoint. The signing region is auto.
